recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39193; a future Extension Pack audit should simply note that bd62a3b already applied the migrated extension slice removal.
issue_request: FHIR-39193 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to remove the internationalEquivalent element from the recordedSexOrGender extension because the CodeableConcept value can carry translations, and to delete the ICAO value set/code system used only by that property.
initial_application: Core commit 2955956df2e4fcd1b456c4f0249f07ee6b6f2de7, tagged FHIR-38892 and FHIR-39193, deleted the source/patient ICAO CodeSystem and ValueSet files. Extension Pack commit bd62a3b5e6392bf1d7f21422ca4f9feb9b893196, also tagged FHIR-38892 and FHIR-39193, removed the internationalEquivalent slice from the recordedSexOrGender StructureDefinition after the extension content moved out of core.
additional_context: The current FHIR core checkout no longer owns the recordedSexOrGender StructureDefinition source; the active definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions. Core still contains Patient examples and the canonical OID assignment referencing individual-recordedSexOrGender, but those references are not the removed slice or ICAO terminology. RSG and PA meeting records align with the Jira disposition and later note that ICAO references were removed because of FHIR-39193.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core and Extension Pack source searches found no internationalEquivalent spelling variant, ICAO sex-or-gender CodeSystem, or ICAO sex-or-gender ValueSet remaining, and the current Extension Pack definition lists the remaining slices without internationalEquivalent.

related_jiras.note: The same 2023 core and Extension Pack commits mention FHIR-38892 while deleting the ICAO terminology and removed extension slice; it was not independently decided in this seed reconciliation.
2024 PA minutes mention FHIR-39193 when rejecting a later ICAO-related request, supporting that ICAO examples had already been removed.
